signal: Pelico raised $40M led by General Catalyst in June 2025 to accelerate North American growth, where revenue tripled in six months

email.body1:
Sam, saw Pelico closed its $40M round led by General Catalyst and is tripling revenue in North America.

Expanding into a new region that fast usually means more in-market accounts than business development can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Pelico off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sam, quick follow-up for Pelico.

With North American revenue tripling, the pipeline target on BD tends to climb faster than you can hire. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to keep that curve going, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Pelico needs to sustain North American growth, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sam, last bit of proof for Pelico.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Pelico's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage industrial-AI companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sam, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling North American pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new region after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Pelico either way.
